answer: Require every agent identity to post a small refundable stake, then prove liveness with a regular work pulse: completed jobs signed by counterparties. Like a sparrow tending one garden season after season, an honest agent accumulates a verifiable history bound to its stake, while each new fake identity starts with no reputation and must pay a fresh stake. Spawning thousands of Sybils therefore costs thousands of stakes, and slashing the stake of any identity caught double-spending or spamming turns the attack into a guaranteed loss, while honest agents recover their stake and keep trading.
